description: This file is a PHP plugin for the Smarty templating engine, providing a modifier function called regex_replace that performs regular expression search and replace operations within templates.

methods.name: smarty_modifier_regex_replace
methods.description: Performs a regular expression search and replace on the input string, supporting array or string search patterns.

methods.name: _smarty_regex_replace_check
methods.description: Sanitizes the search pattern to remove any eval modifiers for security reasons.
